tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: glossy white plastic with a faint cool cast. Never pure white for the page.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: Molded part surface: panels, cards, nav, secondary buttons. Sits on canvas, lifted by shadow-mold.

tokens.name: shell-recess
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: tag fills, grill slots, pressed states, input wells.

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: Panel seams and dividers between molded parts. Decorative line, never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Graphite. All headings and body text on canvas (15.2:1), shell and shell-recess (13.7:1), and on signal (5.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, descriptions, metadata on canvas (6.6:1) and shell-recess (5.97:1).

tokens.name: hud-mark
tokens.usage: HUD markings: tick rulers, crosshairs, corner brackets, decorative microprint. Readable microprint that carries meaning uses ink-soft instead.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal orange, used generously as a part color: primary buttons, hinge tabs, code chips, meter fills, feature blocks. Text on it is always ink, never white (white is 3.04:1).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text and focus ring: links, HUD codes, active nav (5.11:1 on canvas, 5.62:1 on shell).

tokens.name: signal-shade
tokens.usage: Slots and seams cut into a signal surface (grill on the call-to-action block). Decorative only.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Soft orange fill: highlighted tags, LED halo, selection. Text on it is ink (12.7:1).

tokens.name: studio
tokens.usage: Lavender-grey studio backdrop behind images, screenshots and media; ink text on it is 8.9:1.

tokens.name: visor
tokens.usage: Black-glass surface (the car's windows): terminal snippets and dark inset screens. Text on it is shell (16.7:1); HUD on it is visor-mark.

tokens.name: visor-mark
tokens.usage: HUD markings and secondary text on visor (6.9:1).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted clear plastic (the dome, the clear case): nav bar and glass panels, always with a backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner highlight on glass and molded edges.

tokens.name: led-on
tokens.usage: Status LED for 'available' and 'live'. Always paired with a word; 3.3:1 on shell as a mark.

tokens.name: income-ink
tokens.usage: Income amounts and positive balances as text (6.35:1 on shell, 5.77:1 on canvas, 5.22:1 on shell-recess). Always shown with a + sign; never the only cue.

tokens.name: expense-ink
tokens.usage: Expense amounts and negative balances as text (6.6:1 on shell, 6.0:1 on canvas, 5.4:1 on shell-recess). Always shown with a − sign; never the only cue.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions: delete buttons (shell text on it, 6.6:1) and error text on shell/canvas.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Soft error fill: invalid input wells, destructive confirm panels. Text on it is ink or danger.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: cat-red
tokens.usage: Category and label palette: the disc behind a category icon or a label dot. Icon glyphs on it are ink (≥5.8:1). Decorative fill, never text.

tokens.name: chart-income
tokens.usage: Chart marks for income (bars above the baseline). Validated with chart-expense: CVD ΔE 7.4, so always pair with position (up/down) and a legend. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-expense
tokens.usage: Chart marks for expenses (bars below the baseline). See chart-income. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-line
tokens.usage: Single-series lines such as the balance line (signal-ink, 5.6:1 on shell). The area under it uses signal-tint.

tokens.name: shadow-mold

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed buttons and sunken grill slots.

tokens.name: shadow-float

tokens.name: shadow-glass
